data.name: Trainrot
data.detailed_description:
Position: Versatile Employee of Non-Human Personnel and Cargo Transport

Company: UMBRA

Location: █████████

Compensation: Whatever you can keep (and potential bonuses!)

ABOUT THE ROLE

Welcome to Trainrot, an online co-op horror game where the train is your new home, your job site, and your biggest problem opportunity! You and your fellow co-workers are tasked with maintaining the train's fuel, facilities, and performance. Please keep a safe distance from passengers, they DO NOT LIKE YOU prefer social distancing!

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to do physically demanding work, including walking up to 10 km a day, climbing, and lifting or pulling heavy objects up to 80 lb.

  • Communicate with your co-workers under pressure

  • Avoid fatal injury and/or damaging UMBRA equipment for a full shift across various station(s)

  • Excellent focus, attention to detail and ability to multitask

  • Comfortable with squeezing into tight and claustrophobic spaces

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Able to work alone or up to 8 co-workers (players)

  • Versatile in various skills including engineering, sorting, cleaning, and occasionally plumbing

  • Willingness to work in highly volatile environments

  • Must be at least ███ years old

APPLY NOW

Clock in, keep the train running, and try not to DIE break anything!

data.short_description: In this co-op horror game, you are an employee of UMBRA tasked to maintain a mysterious train- feed the engine, repair parts of the train and whatever you do, avoid the passengers.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7800
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
